records.subject: Welcome aboard, Quartz Analytics
records.body:
Hi Felix,

Thanks for joining Wrenfield. If this is your first project-management tool for the team, the biggest adjustment is usually just getting into the habit of logging tasks here instead of a doc or a chat thread.

Happy to help with that transition.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: Positive engaged reply from admin, first project reached day 1 ([email:d17ff7e6], [email:cba8161d]), so momentum exists. But no invite sent in 6 days on Starter and key milestone untouched despite two nudges ([email:30d28ad1]); solo usage often stalls. 8 days left gives moderate odds.

draft.subject: Re: Anything I can help with?
draft.body:
Hi Felix,

Great to hear the first project is starting to click — that's usually the point where things pick up speed. Since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, the next step most teams find useful is getting a teammate in alongside you: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through how your team is splitting up work and where it should land in Wrenfield.

Best,
Priya
